title: anispace (development version)
text: map_to_spherical() returns radial distance origin rho, rather cylindrical radius (#19). theta already used full radius, triple inconsistent name; ISO 80000-2 uses radial distance. lossy well non-standard — point z-axis cylindrical radius zero, (0, 0, 5) round-tripped map_to_cartesian() origin, now returns (0, 0, 5). spherical_to_z(rho, theta) now rho * cos(theta) rho / tan(theta). Code reading rho spherical frame, calling spherical_to_z() directly, needs updating. map_to_cylindrical() unchanged: rho distance z-axis, correct cylindrical frame.

title: anispace 0.2.0 (2026-08-18)
text: Coordinate-system conversion: map_to_cartesian(), map_to_polar(), map_to_cylindrical() map_to_spherical(), element-wise helpers behind — cartesian_to_rho(), cartesian_to_phi(), cartesian_to_theta(), polar_to_x(), polar_to_y() spherical_to_z(). Angular arithmetic: wrap_angle(), unwrap_angle(), diff_angle() calculate_angular_difference(). Rigid transformations: rotate_coords(), translate_coords() transform_to_egocentric().

title: anispace 0.2.0 (2026-08-18)
